messages.content: I think I need to have a hard conversation with my sister about money she owes me.
Honestly, money conversations with family are genuinely some of the hardest. How long has this been unresolved?
Almost a year now, I keep avoiding it.
A year is honestly a long time to carry that quietly - the avoidance is probably adding more resentment than the money itself at this point.
You're right, I think I'm more upset about her not bringing it up than the amount.
That's actually a really useful thing to notice, honestly - naming that specifically to her might matter more than just asking for repayment.
